categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of experimental animal models, primarily focusing on genetically engineered mouse models. It offers a one-stop service platform including model creation, frozen preservation, custom breeding, drug screening, and model sales. Key business lines include commercial mouse model sales, custom model creation, custom breeding, functional pharmacology services, and antibody discovery platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced gene editing technologies such as CRISPR/Cas9, ES targeting, and transgenic techniques to create genetically engineered mouse models. It has proprietary platforms for gene editing, breeding, phenotype analysis, and sterile mouse and microbiota colonization. Automated breeding systems, strict quality control, and AAALAC-standard SPF animal facilities ensure high-quality production. The company also develops innovative models like humanized mice, germ-free mice, wild-type chromosome replacement mice, and antibody transgenic mice.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include research institutions, universities, hospitals, innovative pharmaceutical companies, and contract research organizations (CROs). The company serves both scientific research and industrial clients domestically and internationally. It has over 2,700 domestic customers and more than 300 overseas customers across 20+ countries, including top global pharmaceutical companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production facilities in Nanjing, Changzhou, Foshan, Chengdu, Beijing, and Shanghai, covering all major domestic biopharmaceutical clusters. It has established subsidiaries and offices in the United States (San Diego), Europe (planned), South Korea, Japan, and Singapore, actively expanding its international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the development, breeding, and supply of experimental animal models and related preclinical research services. It provides foundational tools and services essential for drug discovery and development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation and internationalization. It invests heavily in R&D projects such as the 'Spot Mouse' project for large-scale gene knockout models, 'Wild Mouse' project for genetic diversity, 'Germ-free and Specific-pathogen-free Mouse' platforms, and 'Drug Screening Mouse' models covering most druggable targets. It also develops humanized antibody platforms, microbiome research platforms, organoid platforms, and experimental data platforms integrating AI. The company aims to enhance model innovation, expand application scenarios, and accelerate global market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of commercial mouse models, custom model creation services, custom breeding services, functional pharmacology testing services, and licensing of antibody molecules. The company also earns income from import/export agency services and other related technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic players in the experimental animal model industry, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a member of the Asian Mouse Mutagenesis and Resource Association. It holds the largest gene-engineered mouse resource library in China with nearly 22,000 strains and is among the few with nationwide production and sales network coverage. It competes with established global companies like Charles River and Taconic Biosciences but has a strong foothold in China and growing international recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 686.8 million, a 10.39% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 109.8 million, down 30.89% due to expansion costs and increased depreciation. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets around RMB 2.57 billion and equity of RMB 2.13 billion. R&D investment accounted for 13.73% of revenue, reflecting sustained innovation efforts. The company is in a growth phase with expanding domestic and overseas markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive and innovative portfolio of genetically engineered mouse models with proprietary technologies enabling rapid, cost-effective, and high-throughput model creation. Its unique 'Spot Mouse' plan provides a vast standardized knockout mouse library, significantly reducing delivery times and costs. The company also pioneers advanced models like humanized, germ-free, and wild chromosome replacement mice, enhancing clinical relevance. Its integrated service platform from model creation to pharmacology testing and antibody discovery provides customers with efficient, reliable, and cutting-edge tools for biomedical research and drug development.
